definitions.explanation: describes a person who is focused on the external world and who gains energy from social interaction

examples.english: Extroverts gain energy from interacting with others.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{外向|がいこう} (extroversion) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (suffix: -like, -ish)

PSYCHOLOGY:
This is a psychological term referring to how a person directs their attention and derives energy. {外向的|がいこうてき} people feel energized by social interaction and external stimulation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
{外向的|がいこうてき} (extroverted) ↔ ⟦{内向的|ないこうてき}→内向的：08458_naikouteki⟧ (introverted)

USAGE:
Both {外向的|がいこうてき} and ⟦{内向的|ないこうてき}→内向的：08458_naikouteki⟧ are psychological terms popularized by Carl Jung. Most people fall somewhere on a spectrum between the two.

FORMS:
{外向的|がいこうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - in an extroverted manner
